_comment: The natural voices the Windows app can download for reading aloud: Piper voices (VITS, ONNX) from the Piper project's own Hugging Face repository, pinned to one revision. Read by src/neural/mod.rs, which keeps a file only once its size and SHA-256 match these (the values Hugging Face publishes for each file). The voices are spoken with the app's own Arabic rules (arabic.rs), not espeak-ng.
